short: Schur vanishing for relevant degenerate off-diagonal terms

lean.name: Formalism.L2.SG.KappaOffDiagonal.SchurNFC
lean.plain: Schur vanishing for relevant degenerate off-diagonal terms
lean.note: An off-diagonal orbital integral for a relevant degenerate coset must intertwine the two representations on the coset’s pointwise stabilizer. When their archimedean parameters differ at every place, the intertwining condition forces the operator to be zero.
